assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only re-zero:mimi@light-novel#character-model, the canonical V1.0 Mimi V01-V17 source-bounded character model at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the admitted Japanese main light novels; the model itself declares that it rechecks selected delivered ranges of the already consumed V06, V07, V08, V09, V16 and V17 originals and that the V01-V17 label is a horizon, not an appearance in every volume. The project's current-state entrypoint and character-analysis router were read for method, authority order and scope only. The frozen volume readings, the five specialist ledgers and master ledger, the source lock, the separate same-analyst fidelity review, the reconstruction protocol and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them; the model's MONOGRAPH_READY label and PASS_WITH_BOUND local verdict are inputs, not conclusions. No V18 or later volume, web-novel, IF, EX, side-story, game or anime material is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Twelve model-selected phases from the V06 E010 street escort through the V17 E021 critical treatment, each bound to an event state with explicit remembered-history firewalls: the discarded V06 lip-healing encounter is not current mutual memory, the terminal E011 losses are not automatic current grief, and the roughly one-year interval between V09 and V16 is unobserved. The default is the latest state, living but unconscious at E021 with a nonclosing chest wound, in which no awake reply, assent, cure or survival is established; any awake use requires an explicitly selected earlier phase. States after V17, the wound outcome, exact age, birthday and parental identity are not established, and no in-world dates are fixed.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states a thesis (forward engagement toward people, food, recognition and action that is not flawless understanding), a motive and attention account with located blind spots (section 4), twenty conditional rules with trigger, interpretation, priority, exception and confidence (section 5) and an eleven-row rival-reading table (section 10), all routed to twenty-two located bundles. The subject is a supporting character seen in six volumes, never focalized, and the model marks the weights of coexisting motives INTERNAL_MOTIVE_UNDERDETERMINED and labels most transfers of its Garfiel-roof and V08 rules HIGH scene / MEDIUM transfer, so B is not supported; the explicit rule-level structure with exceptions exceeds distributed evidence, so D is not supported.

Section 2 supplies twelve selectors (M06S, M07I, M07W, M08C, M09R, M16G, M17H, M17R, M17M, M17W, M17X, M17U) each tied to an event state and a non-transfer boundary, and section 1 keeps open whether early/later differences are maturation or recipient and danger. The sequence spans V06-V09 and V16-V17 with the intervening year unobserved, no developmental trajectory is modeled and the model refuses a linear learning story, so B is not supported; the state firewall is explicit and located rather than distributed, so D is not supported.

Section 9 records twelve exact short Japanese forms (J01-J12): named self-reference, the おにーさん address, the borrowed ぼちぼちでんなー, the patron rebuke お嬢、イジワルしたらダメー, かしこまりー, どぞー, ガーフ, the nonrequired-reciprocity line, むつかしー, ひゃっ, the urgent repeated prohibition and the breach criticism, plus the general description of long vowels, exclamations, repetition and comic politeness and one documented shift from play to urgent prohibition. Every form comes from two members, V06 p-007 and V17 p-005; no wording from her V07, V08, V09 or V16 scenes is attested, no sentence-ending or lexical inventory exists and the model returns JAPANESE_REGISTER_SAMPLE_TOO_NARROW for formal or unknown contexts, so C is not supported; the forms are exact, located and functionally conditioned, so E is not supported.

Section 6 and bundles E01, E02, E12, E14 and E18 locate stall food and asking for more, requested mouth-wiping, the untidier-room self-report, relaxed sofa behavior and ear-fur permission with Reala, the pastry gift and its sharing, curiosity about Beatrice's hair and the morning proximity negotiation, each paired with a stated limit (no favorite food, routine, finances or sleep needs). The ordinary evidence is mainline rather than supplemental, but it is a handful of scenes in V06, V16 and V17, so B is not supported; it is located and dedicated, so D is not supported.

Section 7 differentiates eleven recipients with supported differences and non-transfer limits. The Garfiel relation is multi-scene and located (E12-E21: wrist-stop demand, other-hand support, scent inference, explicit affection, startled distance, retreat negotiation, breach criticism), the sibling relations are located across V07-V09 (credit to Hetaro, pressure on Tibby, comfort after loss) and the Subaru relation carries the discarded-state firewall. Anastasia rests on V06 only and Reala, Gallek, Ricardo, Julius and Ferris on one or two scenes each, the registers are Mimi-side only and the model says its matched-recipient contrasts are not controlled experiments, so B is not supported; two relations have multi-scene conditioned conduct, so D is not supported.

Mimi is never a focalizing character; interior claims in sections 1, 4 and 10 are inferences from action, speech and narrator or focal appraisal, and the model marks the private effect of the foundling account UNDERDETERMINED, the weights of coexisting motives INTERNAL_MOTIVE_UNDERDETERMINED and the cause of the head-pat startle unlinked (N14). The affirmative material is her own self-reports (E18 family account, since-yesterday change) and her stated love (J07). This is substantial located evidence without an interior model, so C is not supported; it exceeds local canon fact, so E is not supported.

Located conflict spans the patron rebuke (E01-E03), the Whale withdrawal protest (E06), hitting Tibby to interrupt (E08), the corpse blast and sulking under group criticism (E09), the gendered jibe (E10), the wrist-stop demand (E15), the strike-and-escape negotiation (E19) and the direct criticism of Garfiel's breach (E20), modeled by R02, R06, R08, R09, R13, R18 and R19 with adverse conduct retained as adverse. The model itself grades R06, R08 and R09 HIGH scene / MEDIUM transfer and E06 as live contrary evidence to R18, so B is not supported; the conflict set is multi-recipient and rule-structured, so D is not supported.

The evidence shows ethically charged acts and reactions (practical-fairness rebuke of the patron, the excessive corpse disposal that all scold, refusal to let the brothers' risk choice be her assent, allowing a warm person to say no in section 8.3) but no scene in which Mimi weighs a moral question, and the model states that a predicted harmful tendency is descriptive, not approval. Discovery enrolls ETHICS, but no deliberation procedure is supported, so D is not supported; located acts with explicit moral framing exist, so NOT_ASSESSED is not appropriate.

Teasing exhausted Hetaro (E07), boasts and the growth boast (E04, E12), word and proverb play (E12, E17), the comic admission of limits (J08), the service-phrase play (J04) and the pastry and proximity comedy (E18) recur across V07, V16 and V17, with N21 forbidding the cute register in every line or while unconscious. The repertoire is described more than quoted and the quoted forms are few, so B is not supported; it is recurrent, located and constrained, so D is not supported.

The model declares the admitted Japanese V01-V17 horizon, excludes anime, web-novel, IF, EX and wiki material, and routes each bundle to a frozen volume reading and an exact member and block range; it also states that its thirty-five bounded revisits support only their delivered ranges, that the horizon label does not assert appearances in every volume, and that the interval between V09 and V16 is unobserved. The readings, source lock and EPUBs are outside this evidence set and the series continues past V17, so B is not supported; the boundary is exact and located, so D is not supported.

Affirmative located limitations: misreading the Whale's distress as itching (E05), near-hitting Subaru and not seeing the Hands (E11), the mistaken child inference and admitted vocabulary gap (E12), the stomachache guess (E15), admitted incomprehension of the family dilemma (E18), three barriers penetrated and healing that fails to close the wound (E21-E22), intrusive hair-pulling despite protest, hitting Tibby and the scolded corpse blast; twenty-three negative controls and the eleven-row rival table give testable negatives. All of it lives inside one artifact and the control application is the project's own same-analyst review, so A is not supported; these are located counterinstances rather than gaps, so C is not supported.

Every selector is bound to an event state (E010, E011, E012, E013, E018-E021), the default is fixed at the latest unconscious state with explicit refusal to move her back for dialogue, the discarded V06 encounter and the terminal E011 losses are firewalled from current memory, prior-day backfill is not a new return, and disclosure order is separated from acquisition order for her own biography. Development causation and the one-year gap remain open, in-volume order relies on delivered block numbers and the artifact is single, so A is not supported; the firewalls are explicit and located, so C is not supported.

scenario_readiness.note: The attested voice is twelve short forms from two members (V06 p-007 and V17 p-005) with no wording from four of the six volumes in which she appears, and the default state cannot speak at all. CONDITIONAL would license lines that are mostly invention wearing a few attested tics; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located forms and the documented play-to-prohibition shift, which do support recognizing and constraining a line. This bounds the evidence set, not Mimi's speech.

conditions: An awake phase among M06S, M07I, M07W, M08C, M09R, M16G, M17H, M17R, M17M, M17W or M17X is explicitly selected with its tools, allies, received information and remembered relation; the default M17U state yields abstention, never new speech or assent.

The situation closely matches one of the model's probe classes: reachable minor injury, a requested or abrupt touch, a quiet turn in a negotiation, a worried companion, a dangerous passage, a broken retreat, a claimed remembered favor or a family request for risky help.

The interlocutor is an attested relation (Anastasia, Hetaro, Tibby, Subaru, Beatrice, Garfiel, Reala, Ricardo or combat allies) in its attested register, with the discarded V06 encounter and the terminal E011 losses excluded from her memory.

Output is a conditional tendency labeled at the model's confidence (HIGH scene, MEDIUM transfer), retains the adverse conduct the source shows, and abstains on motive weights, exact age, parental identity, the wound outcome and anything after V17.
No mechanics upgrade is introduced: healing, barriers, the roar, scent inference and the hunch stay local and finite, and the triplet sharing supplies no telepathy or consent bridge.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named awake phase between the V06 E010 escort and the V17 E021 reconnaissance, roof and strike sequence; by default the latest E021 state is unconscious and supports no new action, so cross-scenario use always names an earlier phase explicitly.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Anastasia as patron, Hetaro and Tibby as brothers and deputies, Subaru in the memory state the phase allows, Beatrice, Garfiel in the V16-V17 affection-and-boundary state, Reala, Ricardo or combat allies; strangers only in escort, deputy or rescue roles the source attests.
setting_constraints: Escort, stall and meal settings, deputy deployment and coordinated combat, the Cult operation, the household visit, the roof, the morning street or the E021 reconnaissance
No institution, technology or cultural assumption outside the admitted Japanese V01-V17 main light novels
Scene-level rules are not generalized beyond the model's MEDIUM transfer labels
Open domains (motive weights, parental identity, exact age, wound outcome, Garfiel's reciprocity) end in abstention rather than prediction

scenario_readiness.note: Section 12 supplies eight bounded probes with explicit phase overrides, matched-recipient variants, failure risks and abstentions, and section 5 supplies rule-level exceptions. Readiness is conditional because the model grades most transfers MEDIUM, keeps motive weights underdetermined and tests itself only through the project's own documentary review. READY would treat the probe set as validation; NOT_READY would deny an explicit, state-bound application protocol.

conditions: Scenes of attested kinds only: stall food and asking for more, requested small bodily help, an enthusiastic reunion, hospitality with a head pat or ear-fur touch she permits, a shared pastry, curiosity about someone's hair and a negotiated walking distance.

Touch is recipient- and phase-specific: Reala's requested touch, Beatrice's protested hair-pulling and Garfiel's startling head pat are not interchangeable, and no blanket permission or aversion is modeled.
No favorite food, usual diet, room inventory, wages, private hobby, sleep schedule or solitary coping is supplied; the model's ORDINARY_LIFE_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT abstention applies.
An awake phase is selected explicitly; ordinary behavior is never attributed to the unconscious default.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary scenes are mainline and located but few, and the model refuses favorites, routines, finances and sleep needs. READY would invent a domestic routine; NOT_READY would deny the located stall, reunion, hospitality and morning scenes.

The source shows morally framed acts (the fairness rebuke, the scolded corpse blast, the refusal to let others' risk choice stand as her assent) but never a weighed moral choice, and the model models a harmful tendency as descriptive only. CONDITIONAL would turn reactions into a deliberation model; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located acts.

conditions: Mimi-side only, toward Garfiel only, in the M17R or M17M phase (or the V16 M16G reunion for the gaze and age comparison); no other romantic relation is attested.
Her love is stated as not requiring his return; Garfiel's reciprocity, any agreed relationship, sexual activity and a future outcome are not asserted.
Her bodily boundaries stay live: the wrist-stop demand, the startled hand removal and the chosen middle distance are retained, and the comfort scene is not a standing consent.
No V18 or later development, side-story or anime material resolves the relation.
scenario_readiness.note: Mimi's attraction to Garfiel is explicit (J07) and the roof and morning sequence is located in detail (E13, E17, E18), but the whole relation is one night and one morning in V17 plus a V16 gaze reading that Subaru doubts, and the model marks reciprocity ROMANTIC_INTERPRETATION_NOT_TEXTUALLY_RESOLVED. READY would settle a couple the text leaves open; NOT_READY would erase her own declaration.

conditions: Contexts of the kinds narrated: escort duty, deputy deployment with her brothers, the Whale hunt, the Cult operation, the altered-operation rescue and the two-person reconnaissance with its retreat negotiation.
Tools and allies are present and finite: barriers buy intervals, the roar is joint, healing is minor, and stronger allies (Ricardo, Julius) are named as needed rather than assumed sufficient.
Hetaro's withdrawal rationale, his one-more-use limit and Tibby's judgments remain theirs; Anastasia's bargains and company law are not hers to state.
Her tactical judgment coexists with the V07 withdrawal protest, the misread Whale behavior and the near hit; no infallible tactician or universal pacifist is modeled.
scenario_readiness.note: Deputy, escort and combat conduct is the best-covered domain (E04-E11, E19-E21) with a rule for the strike-and-escape negotiation and the breach criticism. READY would hand her Hetaro's rationale and an invulnerable kit; NOT_READY would deny located coordinated operations.

known_limits.statement: The model's default is living E021, unconscious under critical treatment for a nonclosing chest wound with physical hemostasis and intensified triplet sharing; no awake reply, new assent, healed wound or survival is demonstrated, the dropped staff is not assumed recovered, and any dialogue or action requires an explicitly selected earlier phase rather than silently moving her back to an uninjured scene.

The V06 lip healing belongs to a discarded event state that Subaru can remember and Mimi does not; the terminal E011 losses and Radian's death are not automatic current memory; she has no Return by Death, death count or E019/E020 memory and states she cannot see the Hands; prior-day backfill is not a new return, and the roughly one year between V09 and V16 is unobserved.

All twelve attested Japanese forms come from V06 p-007 and V17 p-005; no wording from her V07, V08, V09 or V16 scenes is sampled, the crying-place proverb is partly forgotten and adapted, and the model returns JAPANESE_REGISTER_SAMPLE_TOO_NARROW for a formal scene or unknown older age.

No surname or romanization, exact age, birthday, adult legal capacity or parental identity is supplied; V16 places her approximately at Garfiel's age; the foundling account (unknown parents, the triplets, a finder called ローシ, family with Anastasia and the commander) is her self-report, the abandonment reason is her inference, and the light telling does not establish a painless life.

Her love for Garfiel is explicit and declared as not requiring his return; his reciprocity, any agreed relationship, sexual activity, a permanent cure of his fear and the cause of her later startle are not established, and his private trial, maternal and Elsa reasoning is not transmitted to her by proximity.

The model's PASS_WITH_BOUND verdict is a same-analyst nonblind documentary review of written routing; it states that no independent reviewer, held-out source, measured response benchmark or character runtime was used, that HIGH and MEDIUM are documentary confidence rather than response frequencies, and that generated probes are not evidence.

The frozen V06-V17 deep readings, the event, knowledge, mechanics, institution and relationship ledgers, the master ledger, the source lock, the reconstruction protocol, the separate fidelity review and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject, so the model's member and block locators were not rechecked here and no independent reconstruction test is in the evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
